correctness.rationale: For the quotient with glide g(x,y)=(x+L,-y) and h(x,y)=(x,y+2w), let b=2u,c=2w-b,T=bc. The exact Voronoi inequalities are |x|<=L, |y|<=w, L|x|-by<=(L²+b²)/2 and L|x|+cy<=(L²+c²)/2. For T<=L², all vertices occur at (±(L²-T)/2L, ±w) and (±(L²+T)/2L,w-b), giving e²=w²+((L²-T)/2L)². For T>=L², vertex norms max to (c²+L²)/2c. Both branches match at T=L²; differentiating in u gives decreasing e, diameter sqrt(w²+L²/4), radius (w²+L²)/(2 max(w,L)), central two-sided minimizer circle and the two one-sided maximizer circles. At w>L, T=L² has unique interior u*, corner e left-derivative 0, right -(c-b)/c. Verified separately with 208 exact rational halfplane-intersection radius cases; the proof, not samples, handles all parameters.
